comments.author: BearCubMiami
comments.body:
Sadly the folks here are correct. A winning strategy that you can run mechanically is so difficult to achieve that there’s no way anyone is going to give it up. 

All the stuff online is theory and works for the guru explaining it (for now). The only true strategy I would use is one rigorously back tested for at least 5 years so you can see if it survives different market regimes like 2022, for example. And then see what it does with a crazy run like the one we’ve been on the last 16 months. 

I have a strategy that works and there’s no way I could publish it, because then the strategy would decay prematurely and I would go from profitable to becoming the liquidity in the market. 

My advice is keep searching and backtest many instruments (stocks, options, crypto, futures, etc). 

Here’s an honest gold nugget for you based on where you are today. Don’t give up on a strategy because it didn’t work on what you like to trade. The strategy might be better suited for some other instrument. Keep it simple and try it on everything. You must use 5 years of data, it’s obligatory so you can see different market sentiments.
